prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Spanish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper small flared temple bell, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze miniature anvil, a lead pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver necklaces. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries a dense printed-circuit surface grown over her skin, raised copper traces and solder pads running in tidy right-angled lines over every curve, tiny rectangles of black silicon chips set into the surface, BLAZING glossy white ceramic circuit-board surface with silver traces, VIVID magenta light pulses racing along the traces and small glowing LED points. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Chinese man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth light skin with a warm golden undertone, a soft amused smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver miniature anvil, a gold round bell, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum necklaces. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, orchid formations in DEEP VIOLET and EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
